summary: Verified two changes: (1) removal of inline '+' add buttons and '+ Add New' dropdown options from Customer/Executive/Manager fields in MIS Add & Edit forms, and (2) agent RBAC filter ($or created_by / agent_name). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_agent_rbac_agentname.py with 11 tests - all 11 PASS (agent sees own-name loans, does NOT see other agents' loans, search preserves RBAC, GET /loans/{id} of another agent's loan returns 403, admin sees all, analytics/overview + by-agent scoped correctly). Frontend (Playwright, admin + agent logins on preview URL): Add dialog and Edit dialog both contain ZERO lucide-plus/'+' buttons and ZERO '+ Add New' options; dropdowns show only master data (customers 18, executives 86, managers 11). Inline-add dialog never rendered. Agent MIS view shows exactly 5 rows, all matching created_by=agent-id OR agent_name='Test Agent' (verified against MongoDB), no leakage.

minor.issue: RBAC matches on agent_name string. Two users with the same display name would see each other's loans, and renaming a user silently changes their visible data. Consider matching on agent user_id instead of free-text agent_name.
Agent cannot delete a loan they created themselves (403). Expected per design? Flagging for confirmation - it left QA test data behind that had to be cleaned via admin/DB.

ui_bugs.component: MonthlyMIS Edit dialog - Company Name Select
ui_bugs.issue: When the loan's existing company (e.g. 'TestCo') is not in master_companies the Select renders blank (no '(current)' fallback item), unlike Customer/Executive/Manager which do have the fallback. Value is preserved on save but the field looks empty/lost to the user.

issues: Date, Login Date and Disbursed Date use native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere - inconsistent and locale-dependent display (pre-existing).

action_items: Optional: add '(current)' fallback SelectItem for Company Name in the Edit dialog for parity with Customer/Executive/Manager.
Confirm intended behaviour of agent DELETE /api/loans/{id} returning 403 for own loans.
Consider agent RBAC keyed on user id rather than agent_name string to avoid duplicate-name collisions.
critical_code_review_comments: build_rbac_filter injects a top-level $or; GET /api/loans correctly merges it with search via $and, but any future filter that also uses $or on this query must follow the same pattern or it will silently overwrite the RBAC clause. Consider always wrapping RBAC in $and.
POST /api/loans auto-creates master_customers/master_companies entries, so master data can still grow from the MIS form even though the explicit '+ Add New' UI was removed - confirm this is intended.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* loans/customers during pytest; all removed afterwards. Loan count restored to original 8. Note: 4 pre-existing 'TEST_*' master customers from earlier QA iterations were also purged (master customers now 16).
test_credentials: admin@mhpfintech.com / Admin@123, agent@mhpfintech.com / Admin@123 (agent display name = 'Test Agent')
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use data-testids: add-entry-{month}, month-header-{month}, mis-edit-{loanId}, add-/edit-customer-select, add-/edit-executive-select, add-/edit-manager-select. Sidebar link is 'Month MIS' (not 'Monthly MIS'); month groups are collapsed by default and the per-month add button is labelled '+ Add'. RBAC regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_agent_rbac_agentname.py. Two legacy loans have agent_name 'Agent User' but created_by = Test Agent's id, so they legitimately appear in the agent view.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - both reported changes verified working; only minor/cosmetic observations remain.
